description: Where the montages of nemar.sensor-labels.v1 come from. Each file holds the electrode positions MNE-Python returns for one built-in montage, or reads from one of EEGLAB's files (source, eeglab_source), times scale_to_m, rounded to 9 decimal places of a meter. Every montage is RAS: +x toward the right preauricular point, +y toward the nasion, +z up.

upstream.FieldTrip: FieldTrip template/electrode/standard_1005.elc: 10-05 positions constructed by Robert Oostenveld (Oostenveld and Praamstra 2001, The five percent electrode system for high-resolution EEG and ERP measurements), in millimeters in Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) coordinates on FieldTrip's template head (Colin27). The FieldTrip repository is GPL-3.0 and its website CC BY-SA 4.0; neither states a license for the template electrode files. MNE-Python ships the file under its BSD-3-Clause license.
upstream.EGI: Electrical Geodesics, Inc. (EGI) HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net layouts. FieldTrip states its template/electrode/GSN-HydroCel-*.sfp files were downloaded from the EGI FTP server, and MNE-Python's montage README says its GSN-HydroCel files are taken from FieldTrip. MNE's files hold the same numbers as FieldTrip's (FieldTrip names the 64 and 65 nets without _1.0); the bytes differ in whitespace. No license is stated for the layouts by EGI or FieldTrip; MNE-Python ships them under BSD-3-Clause.
upstream.EGI via EEGLAB: Electrical Geodesics, Inc. (EGI) Geodesic Sensor Net layouts from before the HydroCel nets, in EGI's .sfp format with EGI's fiducial names (FidNz, FidT9, FidT10), as EEGLAB ships them in sample_locs: GSN64v2_0.sfp and GSN65v2_0.sfp (a 64-channel net, version 2.0, without and with Cz), GSN128.sfp and GSN129.sfp (a 128-channel net) and GSN256.sfp and GSN257.sfp (a 256-channel net). EEGLAB's readegilocs.m, given no file, defaults a 64 or 65 channel EGI recording to GSN65v2_0.sfp and a 128 or 129 channel one to GSN129.sfp, with a warning to check the file, and has mapped 256 and 257 channels to GSN-HydroCel-257.sfp since sccn/eeglab commit 3affa98b (2010-09-24); nothing in EEGLAB reads GSN256.sfp or GSN257.sfp. The files record neither their EGI source nor a net version beyond the 64 net's, and have not changed since commit 188434a9 (2010-02-06, no message). No cap model names these nets, so nemar.sensor-labels.v1 never places a recording on them by name; they are kept for template positions a writer names exactly. EEGLAB's LICENSE (BSD 2-Clause, Copyright (c) 2024 Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience) covers eeglab.m and the functions folder and states no license for sample_locs.
upstream.BioSemi: BioSemi head cap layouts (ABC labels, A1 to H32), as spherical angles in MNE-Python's biosemi*.txt. MNE's montage README does not name their origin. BioSemi publishes the position coordinates of its standard head caps (biosemi.com/download/Cap_coords_all.xls, linked from biosemi.com/headcap.htm) with no license statement; its 16, 32 and 64 channel sheets list the same 10-20 names and angles as MNE's biosemi16/32/64.txt, in the same order (spreadsheet SHA-256 38304148957c86b16622a7511c972f268ecbe2a7da2288edd3d59718ab82e2fa); the 128, 160 and 256 channel sheets were not compared. MNE-Python ships the files under BSD-3-Clause.

montages.name: standard_1005
notes: MNE-Python 1.13 renamed the standard_1005 montage colin27_1005 (standard_1005 is deprecated and leaves in MNE 1.14); it reads the same file, in meters in MNI coordinates, unscaled.

montages.name: GSN-HydroCel-32
notes: head_size=None keeps the net file's own geometry, in centimeters, so each net and its Cz variant (64 and 65, 128 and 129, 256 and 257) share their electrode positions exactly; MNE's default rescales each file by its own median radius, which moves the 64/65 and 256/257 pairs apart by up to 0.14 mm.

montages.name: biosemi16
notes: MNE's file names the electrodes by the 10-20 system; this montage names them by BioSemi amplifier bank, as a recording does, in MNE's file order, which BioSemi's layout drawing confirms (bank_labels). The angles are integers, so every position is MNE's.

montages.name: biosemi128
montages.mne_call: angles from biosemi128.txt as written; mne.transforms._sph_to_cart on a sphere of 0.095 m, as make_standard_montage('biosemi128', head_size=0.095) does with integer angles
notes: The angles are read from MNE's file as written, with decimals, and placed with MNE's own spherical conversion on a sphere of 0.095 m (MNE's default head_size; the spherical layout has no head size of its own). MNE's make_standard_montage reads the angles as integers, so an angle written as 11.5 becomes 11; angle_corrections lists every electrode that moves, with the angles as written, MNE's integer angles and the distance between the two positions. Every other electrode is MNE's position exactly.

montages.name: GSN64v2_0
notes: EEGLAB's file, read by MNE-Python's own .sfp reader with head_size=None as the HydroCel nets are: the file's geometry, in centimeters, converted to meters. The older nets put each electrode number elsewhere than the HydroCel nets: about each montage's own center, a median 22% of the head radius from the HydroCel 129 net's place (128 and 129), 19% from the HydroCel 257 net's (256 and 257) and 40% from the HydroCel 65 net's (64 and 65).
